name: nds_3d
statement: The DS 3D engine: a geometry engine (commands packed into GXFIFO 0x04000400 or written to the command ports 0x04000440-0x040005FF; matrix modes and stacks, vertex formats, texture coordinates, normals with up to four lights, polygon attributes, triangle and quad lists and strips, culling, clipping to the view volume, the viewport, the box/position/vector tests) that fills one of two polygon RAMs, and a rendering engine that draws the list SWAP_BUFFERS completed into a 256x192 colour and depth buffer at the next V-blank: rear plane, depth test (less or equal, Z or W buffer), Gouraud shading, perspective-correct texturing from the VRAM texture and texture-palette slots in all seven formats (repeat, flip, clamp, transparent colour 0), modulation, decal and toon blending, translucency with alpha blending and the alpha test, and wireframe. 2D engine A shows the result as BG0.

registers.name: DISP3DCNT
registers.bits: 0 texture mapping, 1 highlight shading, 2 alpha test, 3 alpha blending, 4 anti-aliasing, 5 edge marking, 7 fog, 12 colour buffer underflow, 13 polygon/vertex RAM overflow, 14 rear plane from a bitmap

registers.name: GXSTAT
registers.bits: 1 box test result, 8-12 position matrix stack level, 13 projection stack level, 15 stack overflow (write 1 to clear), 25 less than half full, 26 empty, 27 busy, 30-31 FIFO interrupt (1 less than half full, 2 empty)

registers.name: RAM_COUNT
registers.bits: 0-11 polygons, 16-28 vertices in the polygon RAM being filled

fixed_point.vertex: 4.12 (VTX_10: 4.6; VTX_DIFF: signed 10-bit differences in 4.12 units, added to the last vertex)

front_face: a polygon faces the viewer when (v0 - v1) x (v2 - v1) . v1 <= 0 over its clip-space (x, y, w): counter-clockwise on the screen
limits: no edge marking, fog, anti-aliasing, shadow polygons or rear-plane bitmap; translucent polygons are drawn in submission order (no Y sorting); lighting follows GBATEK's formula with levels in 8 bits; polygons are filled between integer vertex positions (no sub-pixel coverage rules); one-line (flat) polygons are skipped; commands sent while SWAP_BUFFERS waits for V-blank are held and replayed after the swap
sources: GBATEK (DS 3D: geometry commands, matrices, polygon attributes, textures, rendering)
